items.quote: POST /evidence/resolve and the MCP resolve tool (scope evidence) refuse any EvidenceRef.namespace
Every SeamRefusalError raised inside a pydantic validator during REST request parsing
The MCP transport returns a JSON refusal for every refusal REST returns

Not-found lookups return HTTP 404 with the refusal body: UnknownTraceReferenceError (/trace/resolve), UnknownJobError (GET /jobs/{id}), UnresolvableEvidenceReferenceError (/evidence/resolve) and UnknownGenerationVersionError.
ForeignEngineRefusalError is reported as a server-side failure, not as a 422 caller refusal (proposed: 502).
GET /corpus, GET /corpus/counts and GET /jobs/{id} never return an unstructured 500 when the v1 corpus adapter fails.
No ingest input from the caller produces HTTP 500 or an MCP UnexpectedToolError.
Page size and offset are bounded on every path.
